The specifications for the BLUETTI Premium 150 (AC180P) Portable Power Station (code: PWR-001-06) are as follows:

- **Model**: BLUETTI Premium 150 (AC180P)
- **Capacity**: 1,440 Wh
- **Rated AC Output**: 1,800 W
- **Surge Power**: 2,700 W
- **Power Lifting**: 2,700 W
- **AC Charging Input**: 1,440 W
- **Solar Input**: 500 W max, 12 to 60 V, 10 A
- **Self-Consumption**: About 15 W
- **Total Outlets**: 11

**Usage**: Suitable for home brownout backup for a refrigerator, fans, lights, a TV, and a router. It can also run power tools and small cooking appliances within 1,800 W.

**Advantages**: 
- 1,440 W AC charging, equal to its capacity in watt-hours.
- 11 outlets.

**Cautions**: 
- The 1,800 W rated output may not be sufficient for most air conditioning units due to their starting surge. Use the recommender to check specific loads.
- Solar input is limited to 500 W and 10 A.

The price for this product is ₱58,719.00. For more details, you can refer to the [user manual](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0557/7159/4918/files/AC180P_User_Manual_EU_EN-DE_V1.0.pdf) or the [product page](https://www.bluettipower.co.uk/products/ac180p-portable-power-station).

[sheet spine-board / Usage] spine-board (LIF-001-10): Usage
These are general facts for this type of product, not the datasheet of CTI's unit. A spine board is also called a long backboard or spineboard. It is a rigid, full-length board. Rescuers use it with a cervical collar and a head immobilizer to limit the movement of a patient with a possible spinal injury. The Hong Kong Hospital Authority says that a spinal board is used to extricate a trauma patient and transfer the patient from the scene to hospital. Safe use needs training. One maker, Laerdal, says that spinal immobilization devices should only be used by personnel who have received adequate training. The masterlist does not state the material, size, load rating or straps of CTI's board. Ask CTI sales.
[sheet spine-board / Specs] spine-board (LIF-001-10): Specs

[sheet spine-board / Advantages] spine-board (LIF-001-10): Advantages
- U.S. NAEMSP and ACS-COT call the backboard a useful spinal protection tool during extrication.
- U.S. NAEMSP advises a long spine board, a scoop stretcher or a vacuum mattress to help with patient transfers. Transfer is one of the riskiest times for more injury to the spine.
- Some boards let the patient stay on the board for X-ray, CT and MRI. The masterlist does not state this for CTI's board.

turns.user: How do your product codes work?
turns.text:
CTI product codes follow a structured format that helps identify the item, its category, and any variants. The general structure is:

```
PREFIX - GROUP - ITEM [ - VARIANT ]
   |       |       |        |
   |       |       |        +-- optional size, capacity or chemical type
   |       |       +----------- item number within the group
   |       +------------------- numeric sub-group
   +--------------------------- three-letter category prefix
```

For example:
- `MED-001-01` indicates a medical item, group 001, item 01.
- `FIR-002-10LBS-DC` indicates a fire extinguisher, 10 lbs, Dry Chemical variant.

Codes can be written with hyphens, without, or with spaces, and all formats refer to the same item.

doc_type: guide
title: Understanding CTI Product Codes
source: CTI Price Masterlist
---

# Understanding CTI Product Codes

Every item in the masterlist has a unique product code. Understanding the code
structure makes it possible to locate an item, identify its category, and
recognise related variants.

## Code format

The general shape is:

```
PREFIX - GROUP - ITEM [ - VARIANT ]
   |       |       |        |
   |       |       |        +-- optional size, capacity or chemical type
   |       |       +----------- item number within the group
   |       +------------------- numeric sub-group
   +--------------------------- three-letter category prefix
```

Examples:

- `MED-001-01` — Medical department, group 001, item 01
- `FUR-002-87` — Furniture, chairs group, item 87
- `TRA-001-18-42L` — Trash bins, item 18, the 42-litre variant
- `FIR-002-10LBS-DC` — Fire extinguishers, 10 lbs, Dry Chemical
- `PPE-012-01-30` — Traffic cones, item 01, 30-inch variant
[guide]  / Known data issues to be careful about: ## Known data issues to be careful about

A small number of product codes appear more than once in the source sheet with
different items or different prices attached. Where a lookup returns a code
carrying conflicting data, the answer should state that the masterlist has
conflicting entries for that code and that the price must be confirmed with the
sales team. The affected codes are `FIR-002-50LBS-AFFF`, `LIF-002-05`,
`LIF-001-09`, `LIF-003-01` and `FLA-001-13`.
[guide]  / Searching by code: ## Searching by code

Codes may be written with hyphens (`MED-001-01`), without (`MED00101`), or with
spaces (`MED 001 01`). All three refer to the same item.
